intent: A flat rectangular mounting plate with four cylindrical screw bosses standing proud of the top face on a symmetric rectangular pattern, each bored for a machine screw. Plate underside prints flat on the bed.

parts.description: Plate 100x60x4 with four d8 h6 bosses on an 80x40 pattern

engineering_rationale.load_path: screw clamps down through the boss into the plate; boss wall resists radial split
engineering_rationale.worst_case_stress: boss wall at its thinnest radial section, around the screw bore
engineering_rationale.check: boss_wall_mm = (boss_od_mm - screw_d_mm)/2 = (8-3.2)/2 = 2.4 mm >= 1.5 mm min wall (PLA)
